messages:
Amber (PM): quick sync on cohort-based onramp for the new SKU series — want to align scope and launch gates
Mike (Sales): +1, customers keep asking for smaller starter buckets tied to use-case cohorts :eyes:
Lia (Eng): can we avoid per-customer infra changes? we need a routing + quota layer that maps cohorts -> quotas
Derek (Legal): heads up — enterprise contracts will insist on an absolute ceiling and export/data carveouts
Tess (Finance): also need ARR mapping. suggestion: map cohorts -> packaged SKU with fixed price bands so revenue recognition is predictable
Amber (PM): sketch: cohorts = {trial, dev, growth}. each maps to an SKU variant. GA launch criteria: billing mapping, docs, 2 pilot customers, e2e metering + legal clause
Mike (Sales): pilots: propose customer A (adtech) + customer B (education). different embedding profiles but complementary
Lia (Eng): ok but we need to decide softcap vs hard ceiling behavior. softcap -> throttle + alert; hard ceiling -> 429 reject + invoice guardrail
ops-bot: deploy-billing-rule v0.2 started by @Lia
Amber (PM): legal wants a service-credit cap tied to ceilings. Derek, is that doable in the MSA language?
Derek (Legal): doable but need explicit SLA triggers and a cap table. I'll draft suggested clause
Tess (Finance): proposed pricing bands: trial ($0), dev ($99/mo -> 50k tokens), growth ($499/mo -> 500k tokens). add-on: throughput lane priced $X/hr as reserved capacity
Mike (Sales): field asks are for per-route throughput add-on. prefer SKUs over per-token metering for easier quoting
Lia (Eng): throughput lanes mean reserved GPU capacity assignment. not ready for GA; can be pilot-only initially
Amber (PM): Launch gating checklist (short):
- docs + SDK examples
- billing product mapping PR merged
- legal MSA clause drafted
- 2 pilot deals signed and instrumented
- telemetry surfaced per-customer and per-route
Lia (Eng): +1. eng estimate: 3 sprints for quota/routing layer + 2 sprints to wire billing hooks and telemetry
Tess (Finance): I'll run ARR scenarios for the three cohorts and share numbers by EOD
Mike (Sales): I'll line up pilot candidates and send contract templates to legal/sales-ops
Derek (Legal): will post a draft clause in #legal-drafts by tomorrow for review
Amber (PM): decision: proceed to pilot gating. GA scope: no public throughput lanes until after pilot evaluation (target Q3)
Lia (Eng): noted. will open RFC and tracking ticket today
Amber (PM): follow-ups: @Tess run cohort ARR model, @Mike confirm pilots, @Derek draft clause. thanks :thumbsup:
Mike (Sales): thanks all — will ping pilot contacts next week
ops-bot: ticket created: PRO-4387 cohort-onramp-quota-layer
Lia (Eng): sharing a quick config prototype for enforcement semantics:
```
quota_rules:
  starter:
    tokens: 50000
    softcap: 0.8
    enforcement: throttle
  growth:
    tokens: 500000
    softcap: 0.9
    enforcement: reject
```
Amber (PM): perfect. saving notes to notion: https://notion.redwood/sku-cohort-onramp
Derek (Legal): flagged EU export requirement for pilot customers, need region carveouts in MSA
Amber (PM): add EU carveouts to GA exclusions. end."
